subject: check the invariance for scale with second order factor

messages.author: f41f7bee5ac730e8
messages.subject: check the invariance for scale with second order factor
parts:
Hello everyone, I state that I am a novice to R and lavaan. I am trying to test a scale that I have developed and I should calculate the invariance for the gender.

I should have managed to set the CFA (following the script). would someone be able to show me the next steps, indicating which are the commands to use to set the various comparisons? Would you have a bibliographic reference, possibly containing the script?

Thank you

##first order model
 
first.model = '
F1 =~ p11+p12+p13
F2 =~ p4+s10+s12
F3 =~ p16+s25+s26
F4 =~ dt+ds+s9i
F5 =~s5+s17+s3
'

##second order model

second.model = '
F1 =~ p11 + p12 + p13
F2 =~ p4 + s10 + s12
F3 =~ p16 + s25 + s26
F4 =~ dt + ds + s9i
F5 =~ s5 + s17 + s3
global =~ F1 + F2 + F3 + F4 + F5
'

first.fit = cfa(first.model, data=data)
second.fit = cfa(second.model, data=data)
